name: Raschel warp knitting
summary: A flat warp-knitting machine that makes open nets and fine elastic meshes, and that could knit the new synthetic fibres at speed.
how: Feed a beam of parallel yarns to a row of latch needles.
Loop each yarn with its neighbour in a set pattern.
Take up the mesh in a flat sheet and cut the pieces.

origin.note: Wilhelm Barfuss improves the warp-knitting frame and creates the Raschel machine.

adoptions.via: The Raschel machine proved the most adaptable to nylon in the 1950s, and it knitted the mesh of girdles.
Warp-knit nylon gave the sheer, light stretch of the soft bra and the bodysuit.
Warp-knit elastane mesh gave the smooth control panel of the footless tights.
